description: P32 (plan M6-M9 sections 2.10 and 5.11): a crewed siege ballista on a turning sled (scripts/world/siege_engine.gd). It fires only while its crew stands within 4 m of it, turns at 30 degrees a second, shoots bolts at a giant 20-140 m off (one every 6 s of crewed reloading), and breaks into planks; its fall costs every soldier within 30 m 20 morale. Its poise breaks to a heavy blow (a staggered engine stops shooting), and a stage-6 giant can seize it - staggered or without its crew - with both hands and hurl it.
